issue_context.body: ## Bug Report Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks! ### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required) ```SQL use test; CREATE TABLE tbl_51 ( col_334 mediumint(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '-3217641', col_335 mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '2002468', col_336 enum('alice','bob','charlie','david') COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'alice', PRIMARY KEY (col_334,col_336,col_335) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */, UNIQUE KEY idx_116 (col_334,col_335), UNIQUE KEY idx_117 (col_336,col_334), UNIQUE KEY idx_118 (col_336) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_general_ci PARTITION BY HASH( col_334 ) PARTITIONS 6; insert into tbl_51 values(-3112969,3273861,'charlie'),(-3040776,4159759,'charlie'); ``` ### 2.
